summary: Seven-person backcountry party attempting to reach Goodwin Greene Hut hit by extreme cold injuries (-22F, wind); two skiers evacuated by helicopter Sunday night Jan 25, one in critical condition; five more treated Jan 26 with two more flown to Aspen Valley Health and three left at the hut with minor injuries.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight of the Rockies; Colorado Search and Rescue (CSAR)
notes: One row per the Jan 25 night rescue + Jan 26 follow-up mission pair; two posts describe the same incident.
